description: Shared Renovate baseline for prule projects. Language-agnostic policy only; stack-specific rules live in the :node and :java presets.

packageRules.description: Automerge digest bumps for devcontainer images and Dockerfile syntax. config:best-practices pins these by digest, which means base-image security rebuilds arrive as PRs instead of being picked up silently; an unreviewed queue of those is worse than the floating tag they replaced.
Automerge minor/patch/digest GitHub Actions updates; majors still come up for review.
GitHub Actions majors are grouped but never automerged.
